code: map_sentiments <- function(data, lexicon = c("bing", "afinn", "loughran", "syuzhet")) {   # Assumes that `data` has a `word` column for matching   lexicon <- rlang::arg_match(lexicon)   sentiment_dictionary <-    if (lexicon == "syuzhet") {     sentiment_dictionary <- syuzhet::get_sentiment_dictionary()   } else {     sentiment_dictionary <- tidytext::get_sentiments(lexicon)   }   # Add column   data <- dplyr::left_join(     data,     sentiment_dictionary,     by = dplyr::join_by(word)   )   # Remove numerical scores   if ("value" %in% names(data)) {     data <- dplyr::mutate(data, sentiment = dplyr::if_else(value > 0, "positive", "negative", NA))     data <- dplyr::select(data, -value)   }   # Rename column   lookup <- "sentiment"   names(lookup) <- lexicon   data <- dplyr::rename(data, dplyr::any_of(lookup))   return(data) }  classic_sentiment_analysis <- aeolusmicrotexts::load_aeolus(granularity = "microtext", include_headlines = TRUE) |>    tidytext::unnest_tokens(output = word, input = unit_of_analysis) |>    # Did not use loughran or nrc because they sort sentiments into too many categories   map_sentiments("afinn") |>    map_sentiments("bing") |>    map_sentiments("syuzhet") classic_sentiment_scores <- classic_sentiment_analysis |>    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(afinn, bing, syuzhet), names_to = "lexicon", values_to = "score") |>    tidyr::drop_na() |>    dplyr::group_by(microtext, lexicon, score) |>    dplyr::tally() |>    dplyr::ungroup() |>    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = score, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>    dplyr::mutate(total = positive - negative) classic_sentiment_scores |>    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = total)) +    ggplot2::geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +    ggplot2::facet_wrap(ggplot2::vars(lexicon)) classic_sentiment_scores <- classic_sentiment_scores |>    dplyr::mutate(compound = total / sqrt(total ^ 2 + 10)) |>    dplyr::mutate(consensus = all(compound > 0) | all(compound < 0), .by = microtext) classic_sentiment_scores |>    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = microtext, y = compound, fill = consensus)) +   ggplot2::geom_col() +    ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = ggplot2::vars(lexicon)) classic_sentiment_scores |>    dplyr::distinct(microtext, consensus) |>    dplyr::count(consensus) |>    dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) #> # A tibble: 2 × 3 #>   consensus     n  prop #>   <lgl>     <int> <dbl> #> 1 FALSE        34 0.548 #> 2 TRUE         28 0.452 results |>    dplyr::filter(granularity == "microtext", include_headlines == TRUE, research_question == "sentiment") |>    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(microtext, score, fill = label)) +    ggplot2::geom_col() +    ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = ggplot2::vars(model), cols = ggplot2::vars(context_variant)) results |>    dplyr::filter(granularity == "microtext", include_headlines == TRUE, research_question == "nationalism") |>    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(microtext, score, fill = label)) +    ggplot2::geom_col() +    ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = ggplot2::vars(model), cols = ggplot2::vars(context_variant)) results |>    dplyr::filter(granularity == "microtext", include_headlines == TRUE, research_question == "nationalism") |>    dplyr::filter(model == "llama3.3:70b") |>    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(score)) |>    dplyr::select(context_variant, microtext, label, score) #> # text: Loads module chain Spartan's GPU partition requires Ollama (GCCcore -> ollama -> foss/R, matching example scripts server), points OLLAMA_MODELS model store directory, sets OLLAMA_NOPRUNE=1 prevent server pruning unused models (dispatcher pulls ; workers must check existence), starts cluster's run_ollama_server wrapper (Spartan's wrapper around ollama serve — called directly) background, waits respond, checks model exists store. Workers never pull; dispatcher (ADR 0007).

title: Script lines run on an Ollama worker node before it starts pulling tasks — ollama_worker_script_lines
text: Unlike plain ollama serve, Spartan's run_ollama_server binds random port time (shares GPU nodes across users, port 11434 assumed free) reports chosen host:port stdout, e.g. OLLAMA_HOST=spartan-gpgpu126:34267 ollama <CMD>. redirects stdout log file, polls OLLAMA_HOST=... line appears, exports — plus OLLAMA_BASE_URL (env var ellmer::chat_ollama() actually reads, http://host:port form) — probing readiness, every later command job (readiness curl, model check, R worker process ) talks right port instead silently falling back unused default 11434. server log written ollama-logs/<sanitised model>_$SLURM_JOB_ID.log rather fixed relative name: every GPU worker job runs checkout-root working directory (one crew.cluster SLURM job per model, ADR 0001), shared plain filename like ollama-server.log clobbered every concurrent model's worker (crew's relaunch timed-worker model) — worker can read another worker's OLLAMA_HOST= line, truncated/interleaved one. Keying path model slug $SLURM_JOB_ID (always set inside sbatch job) gives every worker job file. log also contains TTY progress-bar redraw sequences run_ollama_server/ollama pull emit, makes grep treat file binary , without -, print "binary file matches" instead actual match — silently breaking OLLAMA_HOST extraction. grep calls force text mode -avoid , result checked emptiness (failing job immediately clear message) rather letting blank OLLAMA_HOST silently produce hostless OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http:// surfaces later confusing ellmer/httr2 URL-parsing error. leading #SBATCH --gres=gpu:<n> line requests GPU(s). gres_gpu lets e.g. "gpu:2" model large one A100's VRAM — see gres_gpu slurm-resources.yml (ADR 0001). crew.cluster::crew_controller_slurm() dedicated gres argument, sbatch keeps scanning #SBATCH directives first non-comment line, crew.cluster places script_lines immediately generated header commands — #SBATCH line still honoured long comes first.

title: aeolusmicrotexts 0.3.0
text: _targets.R, target run_id now always runs. Added R/globals.R declaring models_pulled, run_id map global variables, silencing R CMD check notes. crew moved Imports Suggests: package never calls , _targets.R (via crew::). scripts/submit-structured-output-probe.R now uses read_models(), read_slurm_resources() resolve_slurm_resources() instead ad-hoc YAML parsing. New list_runs(), read_run() read_run_metadata() access promoted runs inst/extdata/results/<run_id>/. list_runs() errors malformed run directories. First promoted run added: 20261019-131523_v0.2.0.9000. ADR 0003 amended promoted-run layout.

title: aeolusmicrotexts 0.2.0
text: Prompt change affecting results (ADR 0008); results earlier runs aren’t comparable. Neither ellmer Ollama shows structured-output schema model, field descriptions (incl. score ranges) never read. system prompt now context variant + task instruction + output specification. output specification new build_output_spec() renders field’s name, description, allowed values type. user turn now puts unit ## text heading (new build_user_turn()); results CSVs still record bare unit. New preview_prompt() prints system prompt, user turn, JSON Schema (marked constraining tokens ) RQ schema context variant. Documented structured output reaches model, score may depend label, docs/structured-output.md; @details note RQ schema. Added jsonlite Imports.

title: aeolusmicrotexts 0.1.5
text: Extracted ADR 0003 results-CSV column check run_pipeline_with_schema() validate_results_schema() R/schema-validation.R. Hardened also check context_variant/granularity enum values fixed ADR 0003 include_headlines logical (previously presence-); research_question/label/score remain unchecked since valid values per-schema, fixed ADR. Grid cells now checkpoint progress incrementally resume disk walltime kill: run_pipeline_with_schema() detects existing output CSVs skips already-scored units, reducing re-computation worker killed mid-cell. analyse_with_schema() now accepts skip_indices parameter support resumption logic; skipped rows simply excluded return value, rather NA-filled filtered downstream. slurm-resources.yml default time_minutes now set 720 (accidentally blank, causing workers killed ~10 minutes ). ollama_worker_script_lines() now exports OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=2048 prevent oversized context windows slow large models. (Longest microtext 361 words long.) Dropped gemma4:26b models.yml (ollama 0.17.5 doesn’t support gemma4 architecture). scripts/sync-results.sh now deletes contents remote dispatcher-logs/, ollama-logs/, crew-logs/ directories syncing , logs don’t pile spartan across sweeps.

title: aeolusmicrotexts 0.1.4
text: Fixed race condition concurrent GPU workers shared single ollama-server.log file, causing worker pick another model’s OLLAMA_HOST (truncated/interleaved line). ollama_worker_script_lines() now writes worker’s server log per-model, per-SLURM-job path ollama-logs/. Implemented ADR 0007: dispatcher now pulls models shared model store via pull_models() (R/model-pull.R) worker launches, writing models.csv manifest (model + digest) traceability; GPU workers longer pull models , verify presence via ollama show fail fast model missing. Removed old central model-store/source column machinery favour single model_store_dir().

title: aeolusmicrotexts 0.1.1
text: build_slurm_controllers() now captures SLURM worker’s stdout/stderr crew-logs/<model>_<job id>.log instead letting crew.cluster discard /dev/null, stalled vanished worker job can actually diagnosed. Completed data pipeline implement key elements ADR 0003. unit_of_analysis include_headlines conditions can now elegantly crossed data constituted run. run_pipeline_with_schema() (run_sentiment_pipeline()/run_nationalism_pipeline() wrappers) now call load_aeolus(granularity, include_headlines) write output matching ADR 0003 CSV schema exactly, instead previous broken/ad hoc columns. Added targets + crew.cluster pipeline (ADR 0001): root-level _targets.R thin wrapper around functions build_slurm_controllers() build_grid_targets(). pipeline creates separate worker model run. Added smoke test procedure
